description: OpenAI Codex CLI as a long-running resident engine node — the same session as engine-codex-resident, invoked with --permissions bypass, which for a resident codex session is the danger-full-access sandbox with approvals never: the turn is no longer confined to its workspace. An unrestricted node acts on untrusted inbound mail — anyone who can reach its inbox, including over a broker or a shared folder, is driving a CLI that will not ask. Only for an agent on its own machine and its own account. `a8s stop`, `restart` and `kill` end the session at once through `stop.invoke`; `status.invoke` lets `a8s ps` show busy or resident. Enable private K7E memory with `a8s vars <name> set MEMORY on`. Pick a model with `a8s vars <name> set MODEL <id>` (or `a8s add ... --model=<id>`); unset means the engine's own default. Set the quiet window per node with `a8s vars <name> set TIMEOUT <secs>`. Set EFFORT to an engine-supported reasoning level; unset uses the engine default. Commit as the agent with `a8s vars <name> set GIT_NAME ...` and `GIT_EMAIL ...`; unset uses git's own config.
